title: NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog: genome-wide association denominator and summary-statistics rail
summary: Infrastructure record for the GWAS Catalog as a correction/denominator rail: a curated, downloadable, programmatically accessible knowledgebase of GWAS associations and metadata, with explicit data-sharing and diversity limitations.

status_history.note: Promoted in rev0018 as candidate-gene/GWAS denominator infrastructure.

place.scope: global human GWAS knowledgebase hosted by EMBL-EBI with NHGRI collaboration/funding

subjects.name: genome-wide association studies and summary statistics

claims.claim: The official GWAS Catalog page identifies the resource as the NHGRI-EBI Catalog of human genome-wide association studies and exposes download, summary-statistics, submission, curation/learning, and genome-wide-significance diagram surfaces.
what_would_change_status: The official page changes or retires this resource description.

claims.claim: Sollis et al. describe the GWAS Catalog as a FAIR knowledgebase providing detailed, structured, standardized, interoperable GWAS data to more than 200,000 users per year, with more than 45,000 published GWAS across more than 5,000 traits and more than 40,000 full P-value summary-statistics datasets at the article snapshot.
what_would_change_status: A newer database article or official release materially changes the scale or capability description.

claims.claim: The same database article and NHGRI glossary preserve limitations: GWAS is statistical association rather than causation, summary-statistics sharing remains incomplete, and ancestry/population diversity issues affect reusability and downstream equity.
what_would_change_status: A later source shows these limitations have been resolved or should be reframed.

evidence_profile.source_depth: one-pass official/homepage plus peer-reviewed database article extraction
limitations: Dynamic home-page counts were blank in extracted lines; scale claims use NAR article snapshot.
Does not import GWAS datasets or associations.
Does not adjudicate clinical utility of individual associations.

type_payload.signal_capture_model: Curated published GWAS, submitted summary statistics, metadata, downloads, APIs, accession identifiers, and curation criteria make large association surfaces visible and reusable.
limitations: does not by itself validate mechanistic biology

handling_notes: Treat genetic association data as human-subjects-adjacent and population-sensitive.
Avoid genetic determinism and clinical overtranslation.

unknowns: No current 2026 exact catalog counts were stabilized because dynamic page extraction exposed blank count fields.
No diversity-monitor or ancestry-specific child record yet.
next_actions: Add current GWAS Catalog release snapshot with stable API/download counts if needed.
Add GWAS Diversity Monitor / ancestry-bias infrastructure record.
Add child records for specific successful and failed candidate genes.

scope_qualifiers.ancestry_or_population_scope: catalog scope depends on submitted/curated GWAS denominators
scope_qualifiers.portability_caution: cataloging association does not imply portability or causality
